body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2024-07-30 (Q1FY25 concall transcript): "our aspiration is that we should secure anywhere between INR4,500 crores to INR5,000 crores of orders this year" Metric: Order inflow FY25. Target: INR 4,500-5,000 cr. Deadline: 2025-03-31. Specificity: range; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-19: delivered. Evidence: FY25 order inflow INR 5,335 cr (Q4FY25 call, 'highest ever'), above the top of the range.
